title: Nevada Caps Tesla Robotaxi Fleet at 10 Vehicles in Las Vegas
detail: Nevada regulators approved only 10 vehicles for Tesla's Las Vegas robotaxi permit — a fraction of the 5,000 Tesla requested — underscoring significant regulatory headwinds facing autonomous EV deployment. The sharp cap reflects state safety concerns and signals a cautious national posture on commercial robotaxi expansion despite Tesla's ambitions to rapidly scale its autonomous ride-hail service.
